properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for validating audit reports on PAM activities
properties.description: It must be possible to provide audit reports on Privileged access management activity history for internal and external audits, and it must be possible to relate (trace back) all privileged access management activities to a specific user account used by a specific user
